stock_behaviour: two partial redraws in one request: the second clears the operations of the first and replaces the paint rectangle, so the first area is never repainted in the browser
our_behaviour: damage accumulates per request: the paint covers the bounding union of all pending rectangles
javadoc_or_contract: Control.redraw: 'Causes the rectangular area of the receiver specified by the arguments to be marked as needing to be redrawn' (RWT Control.java:2149-2150)

stock_behaviour: every polygon and path fill is non-zero winding (canvas default), so self-intersecting shapes fill their inner holes
our_behaviour: SWT's default even-odd rule (win32 ALTERNATE, GTK CAIRO_FILL_RULE_EVEN_ODD, Cocoa NSEvenOddWindingRule); FILL_WINDING on request
cause: RWT 4.8.0 GCOperationWriter.java drawPolyline/drawPath emit fill without a rule
javadoc_or_contract: SWT GC.getFillRule returns FILL_EVEN_ODD unless setFillRule (FILL_WINDING) was called (SWT GC.java win32:4465-4468, gtk:2383,2870)
